description: This file contains unit tests for the SpinLock class in the Abseil library, including encoding/decoding wait cycles, thread safety, and scheduling behavior.

classes.name: SpinLockTest
classes.description: Helper struct for testing SpinLock encoding/decoding functions.

methods.name: EncodeWaitCycles
methods.description: Encodes wait start and end times into a uint32_t value.

methods.name: DecodeWaitCycles
methods.description: Decodes wait cycle count from an encoded uint32_t value.

methods.name: TestFunction
methods.description: Function executed by threads to modify shared values protected by a spinlock.

methods.name: ThreadedTest
methods.description: Runs multiple threads to test spinlock correctness and thread safety.

methods.name: DeadlockTest
methods.description: Tests for potential deadlocks with multiple threads.
